title: macrosolen retusus
intro: Macrosolen retusus, commonly known as the "Indian Cordia" or "Yashtimadhu", is a plant species in the Bignoniaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to promote overall health and well-being. The health benefits of Macrosolen retusus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Macrosolen retusus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-cancer properties.
